patterns.what_worked: The brief's read-first chain plus the read-only SuperSwingTimer reference pinned every behaviour (off-hand arg positions 21/13, target tracking, speed precedence, rescale, combat-exit reset) so the port needed no guessing. Self-wiring the driver frame kept the no-main.lua-edits scope exact, and the family gate as a pure function made the whole matrix offline-testable (228 checks, two mutations caught).
patterns.what_was_hard: run.sh duty counted 33 -> 35 steps while the brief's validation line said 37; resolved in favour of the explicit two-step duty and recorded the discrepancy. The full harness at exit carries two other-lane failures (paladin_state.lua not yet landed; bars_state paladin/warrior count pins mid-edit) - reported as observed in-flight state, not hidden.
patterns.skill_gap: Offline harness cannot load the addon: bar placement/colours, UnitAttackSpeed('target') fidelity and enemy-haste UNIT_ATTACK_SPEED cadence stay in-client checks; Cata/Mists CLEU SWING_* presence is family-gate-assumed, UNCONFIRMED in-client.
